app.title: Sektor 7
loading.tips: Hold the right mouse button to turn the camera. Use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out.
Holding the left and right mouse buttons together makes your character run straight ahead.
You walk by default. Hold Shift to run.
Left-clicking an enemy selects it as your target and starts the automatic attack. Press Escape to clear your selection.
Power Strike on key 1 deals double damage but costs energy and has a cooldown. It only works with melee weapons.
Ranged weapons use up ammunition with every shot and need a clear line of sight to the target. You can find ammunition as loot or buy it from the trader.
Press B to open your backpack and C for the character window. Equip gear by clicking it in your backpack.
Move the mouse over an item to see its stats. In the backpack you can destroy items through the menu.
Outside of combat, health and energy regenerate on their own after a short while.
When your character dies, it loses all experience of the current level. Levels you have already reached are never lost.
Loot belongs to the player who defeated the enemy. The coin pouch disappears after two minutes, so grab your items in time.
Chests are hidden in the world. Each character can open each chest only once. After that it is gone for them for good.
An icon above the head of a trader or drifter shows that there is something to do. Left-click them to talk.
Use /g to write in global chat. Without a prefix, only players nearby can hear you.
Enemies with a higher level than you are more dangerous, but they also drop better loot.
Enemies only chase you a certain distance from their spawn point. If you escape them, they return and heal.
You can recognise doors and other entrances by the mouse cursor turning into a hand when you hover over them. You have to be close enough.
Press Esc to open the menu in the portal (where you can also change the language) and M for the map. Click the map to place markers, which also show on the minimap.
Sell items you do not need to the trader. Scrap metal and rags earn you a little money.
Press F11 to go fullscreen. Browser shortcuts like Ctrl+W are locked there, so you can crouch-walk without closing the tab.

zone.startwelt.name: Wasteland – Sector 7
zone.plattenbau_innen.name: Apartment Block (Interior)
npc.streuner.name: Drifter
npc.streuner.greeting: Keep your head down, stranger. Not everyone survives the night out in the wasteland.
npc.haendler.name: Scrap Trader
npc.haendler.greeting: Metal, cloth, canned goods – I take anything that is still worth something.
npc.pumpenwart.name: Pump Keeper
npc.pumpenwart.greeting: As long as the tower holds water, the settlement holds. I make sure it stays that way. And pray that nothing breaks.
npc.funkerin.name: Radio Operator
npc.funkerin.greeting: Shh. Hear that static? Voices hide in between. You just have to know when to listen and when not to.
npc.kanalwaerter.name: Sewer Warden
npc.kanalwaerter.greeting: See that manhole cover over there? The gates are guarded, the fences high, but underground runs a path that is on no map. Anyone who really wants out of Sector 7 does not go through the gate. Bring a light, a weapon and strong nerves. The rats are the least of your problems.
npc.gildenverwalter.name: Guild Steward
npc.gildenverwalter.greeting: Alone you last a few weeks. Anyone who wants backing founds a guild or joins one.

ability.power_strike.name: Power Strike
ability.power_strike.description: A mighty blow with full force.
quest.clear_raiders.name: Drive Off the Raiders
quest.clear_raiders.offer: Raiders are lurking east of the car wreck and attack anyone who comes near. Clear a few of them out of the way, then we will talk.
quest.clear_raiders.progress: Not enough yet? The raiders are loitering east of the car wreck.
quest.clear_raiders.complete: Well done. That gives us some breathing room. Here, take this. And stick with the scrap trader, he pays for anything that shines.
quest.scrap_for_trader.name: Materials for the Trader
quest.scrap_for_trader.offer: The scrap trader is putting together something useful and needs materials. Bring him scrap metal and rags. You will find both on the raiders.
quest.scrap_for_trader.progress: The trader is waiting for scrap metal and rags.
quest.scrap_for_trader.complete: Exactly what I needed. Here, I put this together for you.
quest.stray_name.name: A Name on the List
quest.stray_name.offer: I keep a tally of those who did not come back. Marta has been on it for four days. She was headed for the warehouse in the southwest, the one with the broken-open roller door. Go and look. And do not bring back anything I do not want to see.
quest.stray_name.progress: The warehouse in the southwest. The roller door stands open, you cannot miss it.
quest.stray_name.complete: Just a ring? Was that all there was? ... Then that is how it is. Take this, for the road. And leave me alone for a moment.
quest.stray_name.objective.0: Visit the warehouse in the southwest
quest.trader_goods.name: Goods Without Papers
quest.trader_goods.offer: I need canned food and dog fur. The fur goes into coats, the cans onto tables, and where both come from is nobody's concern. Not even mine. Just bring it.
quest.trader_goods.progress: Five cans, four pelts. I do not count how you get them.
quest.trader_goods.complete: Clean. Questions cost extra with me, which is why I do not ask any. Here, the jacket was still lying around.
quest.trader_debt.name: Debts Do Not Expire
quest.trader_debt.offer: A few marauders in the southwest have owed me ammunition since spring. I do not send reminders. They do not have to pay it back alive.
quest.trader_debt.progress: The marauders roam the southwest. They are sturdy fellows, do not go unprepared.
quest.trader_debt.complete: Then we are even. With them, I mean. With you anyway. This is your severance.
quest.pump_parts.name: Running Dry
quest.pump_parts.offer: The pump is sucking air. Seal gone, linkage bent. I need scrap metal and duct tape, nothing more. Without water we do not need to worry about anything else.
quest.pump_parts.progress: Scrap and duct tape. I will straighten the linkage myself once you bring me the material.
quest.pump_parts.complete: That will hold. For now. Here, something for your trouble. Drink something before you head out again.
quest.pump_valve.name: The Missing Valve
quest.pump_valve.offer: Someone removed the shut-off valve. That is what someone does who is looking for trade goods. I saw him vanish to the south with the thing under the tarp of a wreck. It was a wreck with a green tarp, south of the power line, not far from the raiders' tent. Take a look at the spot and let me know if it is still there.
quest.pump_valve.progress: The wreck with the green tarp. South of the power line, near the raiders' tent.
quest.pump_valve.complete: So that is where it was. How brazen. I will fetch it myself later when the coast is clear. Here, you earned this.
quest.pump_valve.objective.0: Inspect the wreck with the green tarp
quest.pump_dogs.name: Pack at the Well
quest.pump_dogs.offer: For a few nights now a pack has been prowling around the water tower. They smell the moisture and grow bolder. I do not want someone lying at the well tomorrow with a mauled calf. Take care of them.
quest.pump_dogs.progress: Stray and feral dogs. They lurk at the edge of the settlement.
quest.pump_dogs.complete: Finally some peace. That was not pretty, but necessary. Take this, I still had it from better times.
quest.radio_power.name: Power for the Voice
quest.radio_power.offer: My radio runs on batteries, and they are all gone. One single fresh one, plus duct tape for the contacts and some scrap for the casing. Good equipment is worth more than good friends. The equipment does not betray you.
quest.radio_power.progress: One battery, two rolls of duct tape, three pieces of scrap. Then I can carry on.
quest.radio_power.complete: Listen to that. Static. Wonderful, honest static. Here, for your trouble.
quest.radio_mast.name: The Second Mast
quest.radio_mast.offer: My reception is bad. I suspect the antenna line is chafed through. It hangs on the power line in the south, at the second mast counting from the west. See if something hangs or lies there that does not belong, and report back.
quest.radio_mast.progress: The power line in the south. The second mast counting from the west.
quest.radio_mast.complete: Chafed through, as I thought. Someone cut the cable, on purpose. Interesting. And unpleasant.
quest.radio_mast.objective.0: Inspect the second mast of the power line
quest.radio_containers.name: Between the Containers
quest.radio_containers.offer: I need a new antenna cable. In the container yard in the northeast there is some, in the alley between the green and the ochre container. Raiders hang around there, tidy up a bit, then take a look at the spot.
quest.radio_containers.progress: Northeast, the container yard. Between the green and the ochre container.
quest.radio_containers.complete: The cable is off. I only have to find it. Good work. I have this left over.
quest.radio_containers.objective.1: Visit the alley between the green and ochre container

intro.title: Welcome to Sector Seven
abilities.title: Abilities
abilities.hint: Drag abilities onto the action bar. Dragging one off the bar removes it.
class.soldier.name: Ex-Soldier
class.soldier.description: Years of service taught you to stay calm when things get loud. You hit harder with firearms, and your old training has your back when it counts.
class.butcher.name: Butcher
class.butcher.description: You spent your life working with knife and cleaver. When it comes to close combat you know exactly where to strike, and you are tougher than you look.
class.builder.name: Construction Worker
class.builder.description: Steel-toed boots, hard hat, twelve-hour shifts. You take more punishment than most and do not go down easily.
class.medic.name: Paramedic
class.medic.description: You learned to treat wounds under pressure. Bandages and medicine work much better in your hands than in anyone else's.
class.medic.bonus: +40% healing from Bandage up, bandages and medicine
class.scout.name: Scout
class.scout.description: You know the back routes and find what others overlook. You move faster, get noticed later and pick up more gold.
class.scout.bonus: +10% movement speed, −20% enemy aggro range, +25% gold from loot

npc.apotheker.name: Apothecary
npc.apotheker.greeting: Bandages, pills, disinfectant. You can pay later, if you are still alive by then.
npc.allgemeinhaendler.name: General Trader
npc.allgemeinhaendler.greeting: Cans, tools, odds and ends. If you cannot find it here, you do not need it.
npc.barbier.name: Barber
npc.barbier.greeting: Sit down. A new haircut will not turn a loser into a winner, but you face death better looking sharp.
